en: RentifyPro guidance covers identity verification and rental requirements, booking limits and schedules, owner approval, payments, cancellation, refunds, extensions, and late returns. Eligible bookings offer a 30% down payment or full payment; walk-in balance payment needs owner approval after a recorded down payment. Approved-booking cancellation and rental extensions require owner review. Refunds and exact late charges depend on the booking; insurance, deposits, and fuel terms need confirmation with the owner. Which policy would you like explained?
fil: Saklaw ng mga patakaran ang pagkilala at pagsusuri ng dokumento, mga kailangan sa pagrerenta, bilang at iskedyul ng booking, pag-apruba ng owner, pagbabayad, pagkansela, refund, extension, at late return. Sa mga booking na maaari nang bayaran, puwede ang 30% down payment o buong bayad. Kailangan ng owner approval ang walk-in na pagbabayad ng balanse matapos maitala ang down payment, pagkansela ng approved booking, at extension. Nakadepende sa booking ang refund at eksaktong late charge; kumpirmahin sa owner ang insurance, deposit, at fuel terms. Aling patakaran ang gusto mong ipaliwanag?
taglish: RentifyPro policies cover verification, rental requirements, booking limits and schedules, owner approval, payments, cancellation, refunds, extensions, and late returns. Eligible bookings allow a 30% down payment or full payment. Walk-in balance payment needs owner approval after recorded na ang down payment; approved-booking cancellation and extensions also need owner review. Refunds and exact late charges depend on your booking, while insurance, deposits, and fuel terms need owner confirmation. Aling policy ang gusto mong malaman?
